        f"Regen Liner ({liner['material_name']}) & Outer Shell ({shell['shell_material_name']}) Sizing | "
        f"Chamber Mass: {struct_results['mass_total_chamber_kg']:.2f} kg",
        fontsize=13, fontweight="bold"
    )

    # 1. Inner Liner Thickness Comparison
    axs[0, 0].plot(z_in, liner["t_liner_structural"] * 1e3, "b--", lw=1.8, label="Structural Thickness $t_{w,struct}$")
    axs[0, 0].plot(z_in, liner["t_liner_thermal"] * 1e3, "r:", lw=1.8, label="Thermal/Ratcheting $t_{w,thermal}$")
    axs[0, 0].plot(z_in, liner["t_liner_selected"] * 1e3, "k-", lw=2.5, label="Selected Priority $\\max(t_{struct}, t_{th})$")
    axs[0, 0].set_title(f"1. Inner Liner Thickness ({liner['material_name']})")
    axs[0, 0].set_xlabel("Axial Position, z [in]")
    axs[0, 0].set_ylabel("Liner Thickness [mm]")
    axs[0, 0].legend(loc="best")
    axs[0, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    # 2. Liner Selected Thickness vs. 1D Fourier Conduction Ceiling
    axs[0, 1].plot(z_in, liner["t_liner_selected"] * 1e3, "k-", lw=2.2, label="Selected Liner $t_w$")
    axs[0, 1].plot(z_in, np.minimum(liner["t_liner_max_fourier"] * 1e3, 15.0), "r--", lw=1.8,
                   label="Max Fourier Thermal Ceiling $t_{w,max}$")
    axs[0, 1].fill_between(
        z_in, liner["t_liner_selected"] * 1e3,
        np.minimum(liner["t_liner_max_fourier"] * 1e3, 15.0),
        color="green", alpha=0.12, label="Safe Conduction Margin"
    )
    axs[0, 1].set_title("2. Liner Conduction Overheat Margin")
    axs[0, 1].set_xlabel("Axial Position, z [in]")
    axs[0, 1].set_ylabel("Thickness [mm]")
    axs[0, 1].legend(loc="best")
    axs[0, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    # 3. Outer Closeout Shell Thickness Comparison
    axs[1, 0].plot(z_in, shell["t_shell_structural"] * 1e3, "b--", lw=1.8, label="Structural Vessel $t_{shell,struct}$")
    axs[1, 0].plot(z_in, shell["t_shell_thermal"] * 1e3, "r:", lw=1.8, label="Thermal Expansion $t_{shell,thermal}$")
    axs[1, 0].plot(z_in, shell["t_shell_selected"] * 1e3, "k-", lw=2.5, label="Selected Priority $\\max(t_{struct}, t_{th})$")
    axs[1, 0].set_title(f"3. Outer Shell Thickness After Channels ({shell['shell_material_name']})")
    axs[1, 0].set_xlabel("Axial Position, z [in]")
    axs[1, 0].set_ylabel("Outer Shell Thickness [mm]")
    axs[1, 0].legend(loc="best")
    axs[1, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    # 4. Complete Radial CAD Wall Stack-Up
    r_liner_out_mm = r_inner_mm + ch["tw"] * 1e3
    r_ch_out_mm = shell["r_shell_inner"] * 1e3
    r_shell_out_mm = shell["r_shell_outer"] * 1e3

    axs[1, 1].plot(z_in, r_inner_mm, "r-", lw=1.8, label="Hot-Gas Wall $r_{gas}$")
    axs[1, 1].plot(z_in, r_liner_out_mm, "orange", lw=1.5, label="Liner Outer / Channel Floor")
    axs[1, 1].plot(z_in, r_ch_out_mm, "c--", lw=1.5, label="Channel Roof / Shell Inner $r_{shell,in}$")
    axs[1, 1].plot(z_in, r_shell_out_mm, "k-", lw=2.2, label="Outer Structural Shell $r_{shell,out}$")
    axs[1, 1].fill_between(z_in, r_inner_mm, r_liner_out_mm, color="orange", alpha=0.35)
    axs[1, 1].fill_between(z_in, r_liner_out_mm, r_ch_out_mm, color="cyan", alpha=0.25)
    axs[1, 1].fill_between(z_in, r_ch_out_mm, r_shell_out_mm, color="gray", alpha=0.45)

    axs[1, 1].set_title("4. Full 3D CAD Radial Wall Stack-Up")
    axs[1, 1].set_xlabel("Axial Position, z [in]")
    axs[1, 1].set_ylabel("Radius [mm]")
    axs[1, 1].legend(loc="best")
    axs[1, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.95])
==================== FILE: engineDesigner_v6.0/Outputs/__init__.py ====================


==================== FILE: engineDesigner_v6.0/Solvers/ChannelSolver.py ====================

import numpy as np
from Functions.CoolantProperties import (get_coolant_h, get_coolant_props)
from Functions.HeatTransfer import (coolant_htc, bartz_hg, fin_efficiency)
from Functions.PressureDrop import dPdarcyWeisbach, dPfluidAcceleration
from EngineParameters import mdot, MR, P_cool_out_desired
from Geometry.Contour import getCurrentEngineParameters
from Solvers.HotGasFlowSolver import getGasPropertiesCEA



def CoolantChannelSolver(T_in_coolant, contour, channel, hot_gas):
    gas = getGasPropertiesCEA()
    geometry_params = getCurrentEngineParameters()

    #Get contour geometry
    N = contour["N"]
    A = contour["A"]
    ds = contour["ds"]

    #Get channel geometry
    N_ch = channel["N_ch"]
    w_ch = channel["w_ch"]
    w_fin = channel["w_fin"]
    h_ch = channel["h_ch"]
    A_ch = channel["A_ch"]
    Dh = channel["Dh"]
    tw = channel["tw"]
    roughness = channel["roughness"]
    material = channel["material"]

    #get hot gas flow
    M = hot_gas["M"]
    Taw = hot_gas["Taw"]

    #get channel flow rate
    mdot_f = mdot / (1 + MR)
    mdot_ch = mdot_f/N_ch

    #Setup Arrays to calculate thermo-fluid properties at every station along the channel
    P_cool_array = np.zeros(N) #pressure along channel
    h_cool_array = np.zeros(N) #enthalpy along channel
    T_cool_array = np.zeros(N) #bulk temperature along channel 
    q_flux_array = np.zeros(N) #heat flux along channel 
    Twg_array = np.zeros(N) #hot-gas side wall temperature along channel
    Twc_array = np.zeros(N) # cold-gas side wall temperature along channel

    # Helper to solve radial 1D thermal resistance network at any station i
    def solve_station_thermal(i, Tc, hc, ds_local, Twg_init, Twc_init):
        Ag = (w_ch[i] + w_fin[i]) * ds_local
        Twg_old, Twc_old = Twg_init, Twc_init

        for _ in range(400):
            Tw_avg = 0.5 * (Twg_old + Twc_old)
            kw = material.get("thermal_conductivity", T=Tw_avg)
            hg = bartz_hg(A[i], M[i], Twg_old)

            N_fin = fin_efficiency(hc, kw, h_ch[i], w_fin[i])
            A_eff = (w_ch[i] + 2.0 * N_fin * h_ch[i]) * ds_local

            R_g = 1.0 / (hg * Ag)
            R_wall = tw[i] / (Ag * kw)
            R_c = 1.0 / (hc * A_eff)
            Q = (Taw[i] - Tc) / (R_g + R_wall + R_c)

            Twg_new = Taw[i] - Q / (hg * Ag)
            Twc_new = Tc + Q / (hc * A_eff)

            if abs(Twg_new - Twg_old) < 0.01 and abs(Twc_new - Twc_old) < 0.01:
                return Q, Q / Ag, Twg_new, Twc_new

            Twg_old, Twc_old = Twg_new, Twc_new

        return Q, Q / Ag, Twg_old, Twc_old

    #make a guess for inlet pressure
    P_in_guess = P_cool_out_desired + 40.0 * 6894.75729 #guessing 400psi + convert to Pa

    for _ in range(400):
        P_cool_array[N - 1] = P_in_guess
        h_cool_array[N - 1] = get_coolant_h(T_in_coolant, P_in_guess)

        for i in range(N - 1, 0, -1):
            coolant_props = get_coolant_props(P_cool_array[i], h_cool_array[i])
            Tc = coolant_props["T"]
            rho_up = coolant_props["rho"]
            mu_c = coolant_props["mu"]
            k_c = coolant_props["k"]
            Pr_c = coolant_props["Pr"]

            T_cool_array[i] = Tc
            Vc = mdot_ch / (rho_up * A_ch[i])
            Re = rho_up * Vc * Dh[i] / mu_c
            hc, _ = coolant_htc(Re, Pr_c, k_c, roughness, Dh[i])

            Twg_init = 800.0 if i == N - 1 else Twg_array[i + 1]
            Twc_init = 700.0 if i == N - 1 else Twc_array[i + 1]

            Q, q_flux, Twg_conv, Twc_conv = solve_station_thermal(
                i, Tc, hc, ds[i - 1], Twg_init, Twc_init
            )
            q_flux_array[i] = q_flux
            Twg_array[i] = Twg_conv
            Twc_array[i] = Twc_conv

            # Update downstream enthalpy (station i-1)
            h_cool_array[i - 1] = h_cool_array[i] + Q / mdot_ch

            # Evaluate downstream density rho_down for true thermal acceleration dP
            props_down = get_coolant_props(P_cool_array[i], h_cool_array[i - 1])
            rho_down = props_down["rho"]

            dP_friction = dPdarcyWeisbach(Re, rho_up, Vc, ds[i - 1], roughness, Dh[i])
            dP_acceleration = dPfluidAcceleration(A_ch[i - 1], A_ch[i], rho_down, rho_up, mdot_ch)

            P_cool_array[i - 1] = P_cool_array[i] - dP_friction - dP_acceleration
            if P_cool_array[i - 1] <= 0:
                raise ValueError("Coolant pressure became non-positive")

        # Populate station i = 0 (Injector exit) so arrays have no zeros at index 0
        props_0 = get_coolant_props(P_cool_array[0], h_cool_array[0])
        T_cool_array[0] = props_0["T"]
        Vc_0 = mdot_ch / (props_0["rho"] * A_ch[0])
        Re_0 = props_0["rho"] * Vc_0 * Dh[0] / props_0["mu"]
        hc_0, _ = coolant_htc(Re_0, props_0["Pr"], props_0["k"], roughness, Dh[0])
        _, q_flux_array[0], Twg_array[0], Twc_array[0] = solve_station_thermal(
            0, props_0["T"], hc_0, ds[0], Twg_array[1], Twc_array[1]
        )

        # Check outlet pressure convergence
        P_cool_out = P_cool_array[0]
        error_Pressure = P_cool_out_desired - P_cool_out
        if abs(error_Pressure) < 100.0:
            break

        P_in_guess += error_Pressure

    return {
        "P_cool": P_cool_array,
        "h_cool": h_cool_array,
        "T_cool": T_cool_array,
        "q_flux": q_flux_array,
        "Twg": Twg_array,
        "Twc": Twc_array
    }
==================== FILE: engineDesigner_v6.0/Solvers/HotGasFlowSolver.py ====================

import numpy as np
from Geometry.Contour import getCurrentEngineParameters
from EngineParameters import(fuel, oxidizer, Pc, MR, Cstar_eff)
from Functions import HotGasFlow
from rocketcea.cea_obj import CEA_Obj

# --- 1. CALCULATE GAS PROPERTIES USING CEA ---
def getGasPropertiesCEA():

    geometry_params = getCurrentEngineParameters()
    eps_exp = geometry_params["eps"]   

    rocket = CEA_Obj(oxName=oxidizer, fuelName=fuel)
    Isp, Cstar, T0, MW, gamma = rocket.get_IvacCstrTc_exitMwGam(Pc, MR, eps_exp, 1, 0)
    cp, mu, k, Pr= rocket.get_Chamber_Transport(Pc, MR, eps_exp, 1)

    #Calculate Cstar actual to be used in Bartz Later
    Cstar_actual = Cstar*Cstar_eff

    # Convert RocketCEA default units to SI
    T0 *= 5.0 / 9.0      # deg R -> K
    Cstar_actual *= 0.3048      # ft/s -> m/s
    mu *= 1e-4 #millipoise -> Pa*s
    k  *= 0.4184 #mcal/(cm*s*K) -> W/(m*K)
    cp *= 4184.0 #cal/(gK) -> J/(kgK)

    # Specific gas constant
    R = 8314.4626 / MW

    return {
        "T0": T0,
        "MW": MW,
        "gamma": gamma,
        "cp_g": cp,
        "mu_g": mu,
        "k_g": k,
        "Pr": Pr,
        "R": R,
        "Cstar_actual": Cstar_actual
    }

# --- 3. CALCULATE FLOW PROPERTIES ALONG ENGINE ---

def getHotGasFlow(contour):

    # Convert chamber pressure to SI
    Pc_Pa = Pc * 6894.75729

    #Get engine geometry
    A = contour["A"]
    throat_index = contour["throat_index"]
    N = contour["N"]

    #Get hot gas properties
    gas = getGasPropertiesCEA()
    gamma = gas["gamma"]
    T0 = gas["T0"]
    Pr = gas["Pr"]
    R = gas["R"]

    #Initialize Arrays With Outputs that will be calculated later
    area_ratio = np.zeros(N)
    M = np.zeros(N)
    T = np.zeros(N)
    Taw = np.zeros(N)
    P = np.zeros(N)
    rho = np.zeros(N)
    V = np.zeros(N)

    #1D Quasi Flow Analysis
    for i in range(N):
        
        #Solve for area ratio
        area_ratio[i] = A[i] / A[throat_index]
        
        #Solve for mach number using Area-Mach Relation
        if i < throat_index:
            M[i] = HotGasFlow.solve_mach(area_ratio[i],gamma,"subsonic")
        elif i == throat_index:
            M[i] = 1.0
        else:
            M[i] = HotGasFlow.solve_mach(area_ratio[i], gamma, "supersonic")
        
        #Solve for static temperature
        T[i] = HotGasFlow.static_temperature(T0, gamma, M[i])

        #Solve for adabiatic wall temperature
        Taw[i] = HotGasFlow.adiabatic_wall_temperature(T[i], T0, Pr)
        
        #Solve for static pressure
        P[i] = HotGasFlow.static_pressure(Pc_Pa, gamma, M[i])
        
        #Solve for density
        rho[i] = HotGasFlow.density(P[i], R, T[i])
        
        #Solve for Gas Velocity
        V[i] = HotGasFlow.gas_velocity(M[i], gamma, R, T[i])

    return {
        "M": M,
        "T": T,
        "Taw": Taw,
        "P": P,
        "rho": rho,
        "V": V
        }

==================== FILE: engineDesigner_v6.0/Solvers/ManifoldSolver.py ====================

import numpy as np
from fullflow import Network, State, Component, Balance, SteadyState, DarcyWeisbach
from Functions import PressureDrop as pd

#Single feed pipe splitting into two symmetric 180-deg manifold streams at split angle alpha
class ManifoldInletSplit(Component):
    def __init__(self, name, network, mdot_pipe, P_pipe, P_man_inlet,
                 rho, A_pipe, A_man_inlet, split_angle_deg=90.0):
        self.residual = 0.0
        self.setup()

    def evaluate_states(self):
        _, dP_static = pd.dPinletSplit(
            self.mdot_pipe.value,
            self.rho.value,
            self.A_pipe.value,
            self.A_man_inlet.value,
            self.split_angle_deg.value
        )
        self.residual = ((self.P_pipe.value - dP_static) - self.P_man_inlet.value) / 1e5

    @property
    def balances(self):
        return [(self.P_man_inlet, self.residual)]

#Circumferential manifold segment between channel i and channel i+1.
# Balances wall friction against deceleration momentum static pressure regain.
class ManifoldRingSegment(Component):
    def __init__(self, name, network, P_up, P_down, mdot_up, mdot_down,
                 A_up, A_down, Dh_up, Dh_down, dL, rho, mu, roughness):
        self.p_seg_residual = 0.0
        self.setup()

    def evaluate_states(self):
        dP_static_change, _ = pd.dPmanifoldSegment(
            self.mdot_up.value,
            self.mdot_down.value,
            self.A_up.value,
            self.A_down.value,
            self.Dh_up.value,
            self.Dh_down.value,
            self.dL.value,
            self.rho.value,
            self.mu.value,
            self.roughness.value
        )
        self.p_seg_residual = ((self.P_up.value + dP_static_change) - self.P_down.value) / 1e5

    @property
    def balances(self):
        return [(self.P_down, self.p_seg_residual)]

#90-degree branch takeoff + area contraction from manifold station i into cooling channel i.
class ManifoldBranchNode(Component):
    def __init__(self, name, network, P_man_local, P_ch_entry, mdot_man_in,
                 mdot_ch, A_man, A_ch, rho):
        self.p_branch_residual = 0.0
        self.setup()

    def evaluate_states(self):
        dP_branch = pd.dPchannelBranch(
            self.mdot_man_in.value,
            self.mdot_ch.value,
            self.A_man.value,
            self.A_ch.value,
            self.rho.value
        )
        self.p_branch_residual = ((self.P_man_local.value - dP_branch) - self.P_ch_entry.value) / 1e5

    @property
    def balances(self):
        return [(self.P_ch_entry, self.p_branch_residual)]

# Builds and solves the 1D FullFlow network for a given manifold area schedule.
def solveManifoldFlowNetwork(A_man_profile, Dh_man_profile, inlet_angle_deg, engine_params, channel_geom):
    net = Network("Manifold_Cooling_Network")

    N_half = channel_geom["N_channels"] // 2
    mdot_total = engine_params["mdot_total"]
    mdot_half_target = 0.5 * mdot_total
    rho = engine_params["rho"]
    mu = engine_params["mu"]
    roughness = engine_params["roughness"]
    P_exit = engine_params["P_collector_exit"]

    # Dynamically compute channel friction factor from current (nominal or uncertain) parameters
    Dh_ch = channel_geom["Dh_channel"]
    scale_factor = channel_geom.get("scale_factor", 1.0)
    A_ch_single = channel_geom["A_channel_avg"] / scale_factor
    mdot_ch_single_nom = (mdot_half_target / N_half) / scale_factor

    # Adjust A_ch if Dh_channel is perturbed under uncertainty (holding aspect ratio constant)
    Dh_nom = channel_geom.get("Dh_channel_nominal", Dh_ch)
    area_dh_scale = (Dh_ch / Dh_nom) ** 2
    A_ch_eff = channel_geom["A_channel_avg"] * area_dh_scale
    A_ch_inlet_eff = channel_geom["A_ch_inlet"] * area_dh_scale

    V_ch_nom = mdot_ch_single_nom / (rho * (A_ch_single * area_dh_scale))
    Re_ch_nom = (rho * V_ch_nom * Dh_ch) / mu
    f_ch_base = float(pd.darcyWeishbachFriction(Re_ch_nom, roughness, Dh_ch))
    # Multiply by thermal/curvature multiplier from nominal coupled ChannelSolver if available
    f_mult = channel_geom.get("f_Save_multiplier", 1.0)
    f_channel_active = np.clip(f_ch_base * f_mult, 0.005, 0.35)

    d_theta = np.pi / N_half
    dL_segment = channel_geom["R_manifold"] * d_theta

    P_inlet = State(engine_params["P_inlet_guess"], bounds=(P_exit + 1e4, 5e8), keep_feasible=True)
    P_man_0 = State(engine_params["P_inlet_guess"] * 0.98, bounds=(P_exit + 1e3, 5e8), keep_feasible=True)

    ManifoldInletSplit(
        "Inlet_Split", net,
        mdot_pipe=mdot_total,
        P_pipe=P_inlet,
        P_man_inlet=P_man_0,
        rho=rho,
        A_pipe=engine_params["A_feed_pipe"],
        A_man_inlet=A_man_profile[0],
        split_angle_deg=inlet_angle_deg
    )

    P_nodes = [P_man_0]
    mdot_channels = []
    mdot_man_rem = State(mdot_half_target)

    for i in range(N_half):
        P_ch_in = State(P_man_0.value * 0.95, bounds=(P_exit + 100.0, 5e8), keep_feasible=True)
        mdot_ch = State(mdot_half_target / N_half, bounds=(1e-6, mdot_half_target), keep_feasible=True)
        mdot_channels.append(mdot_ch)

        ManifoldBranchNode(
            f"Branch_{i}", net,
            P_man_local=P_nodes[i],
            P_ch_entry=P_ch_in,
            mdot_man_in=mdot_man_rem,
            mdot_ch=mdot_ch,
            A_man=A_man_profile[i],
            A_ch=A_ch_inlet_eff,
            rho=rho
        )

        DarcyWeisbach(
            f"CoolingChannel_{i}", net,
            mass_flow=mdot_ch,
            upstream_pressure=P_ch_in,
            downstream_pressure=P_exit,
            length=channel_geom["L_channel"],
            hydraulic_diameter=Dh_ch,
            density=rho,
            cross_sectional_area=A_ch_eff,
            friction_factor=f_channel_active
        )

        if i < N_half - 1:
            mdot_man_next = State.maximum(mdot_man_rem - mdot_ch, 1e-6)
            P_next = State(P_nodes[i].value, bounds=(P_exit + 1e3, 5e8), keep_feasible=True)
            P_nodes.append(P_next)

            ManifoldRingSegment(
                f"RingSeg_{i}", net,
                P_up=P_nodes[i],
                P_down=P_next,
                mdot_up=mdot_man_rem,
                mdot_down=mdot_man_next,
                A_up=A_man_profile[i],
                A_down=A_man_profile[i + 1],
                Dh_up=Dh_man_profile[i],
                Dh_down=Dh_man_profile[i + 1],
                dL=dL_segment,
                rho=rho,
                mu=mu,
                roughness=roughness
            )
            mdot_man_rem = mdot_man_next

    total_ch_flow = sum(mdot_channels[1:], mdot_channels[0])
    Balance(
        "Total_Mass_Balance", net,
        variable=P_inlet,
        function=(total_ch_flow - mdot_half_target) / mdot_half_target
    )

    SteadyState(net).solve(solver_method="trf", ftol=1e-7, xtol=1e-7, rtol=1e-2, verbose=False)

    channel_flows = np.array([ch.value for ch in mdot_channels])
    p_static_ring = np.array([p.value for p in P_nodes])

    # Spatial static pressure variation (allows momentum regain while keeping profile smooth/uniform)
    p_static_std = float(np.std(p_static_ring))
    p_static_cov_pct = 100.0 * p_static_std / np.mean(p_static_ring)

    return {
        "mdot_distribution": channel_flows,
        "P_static_manifold": p_static_ring,
        "P_static_std": p_static_std,
        "P_static_cov_pct": p_static_cov_pct,
        "maldistribution_pct": 100.0 * (np.max(channel_flows) - np.min(channel_flows)) / np.mean(channel_flows),
        "dP_static_end_to_end": p_static_ring[0] - p_static_ring[-1],
        "P_inlet_required": P_inlet.value,
        "dP_total": P_inlet.value - P_exit
    }
==================== FILE: engineDesigner_v6.0/Solvers/StructuralSolver.py ====================


import copy
import numpy as np
import EngineParameters as ep
from Geometry.LinerShell import getLinerGeometry, getOuterShellGeometry
from Functions.Structural import calcRevolvedShellMass
from Solvers.ChannelSolver import CoolantChannelSolver


def solveRegenStructuralShells(contour, channel, hot_gas, coolant_flow=None,
                               liner_material=None, shell_material=None,
                               couple_liner_heat_transfer=True, max_iter=2):
    """
    Coupled Thermo-Structural Solver:
    1. Evaluates Liner thickness (max of structural vs. thermal) via Geometry.LinerShell.
    2. Iterates with CoolantChannelSolver so variable t_liner(z) updates wall conduction
       resistance (R_wall = tw / (Ag * kw)) and channel pitch.
    3. Evaluates Outer Shell thickness (max of structural vs. thermal) after cooling channels.
    4. Integrates Liner, Rib, and Outer Shell masses using matprotlib densities.
    """
    channel_work = copy.deepcopy(channel)
    if liner_material is not None:
        channel_work["material"] = ep.load_matprotlib_material(liner_material)

    if coolant_flow is None:
        coolant_flow = CoolantChannelSolver(ep.T_cool_in, contour, channel_work, hot_gas)

    n_loops = max_iter if couple_liner_heat_transfer else 1
    for _ in range(n_loops):
        liner_geom = getLinerGeometry(
            contour, channel_work, hot_gas, coolant_flow,
            material=channel_work["material"]
        )
        tw_new = liner_geom["t_liner_selected"]

        if np.max(np.abs(tw_new - channel_work["tw"])) < 1e-5 or not couple_liner_heat_transfer:
            channel_work["tw"] = tw_new
            break

        # Update channel liner thickness and local pitch
        channel_work["tw"] = tw_new
        r_ch = contour["r"] + tw_new + 0.5 * channel_work["h_ch"]
        pitch = 2.0 * np.pi * r_ch / channel_work["N_ch"]
        channel_work["w_fin"] = np.maximum(pitch - channel_work["w_ch"], 0.2e-3)
        channel_work["f_fin"] = channel_work["w_fin"] / pitch

        coolant_flow = CoolantChannelSolver(ep.T_cool_in, contour, channel_work, hot_gas)

    shell_geom = getOuterShellGeometry(
        contour, channel_work, coolant_flow,
        t_liner_profile=channel_work["tw"],
        liner_material=channel_work["material"],
        shell_material=shell_material
    )

    rho_liner = float(liner_geom["material"].get("density"))
    rho_shell = float(shell_geom["material"].get("density"))

    _, mass_liner = calcRevolvedShellMass(
        contour["z"], contour["r"], channel_work["tw"], rho_liner, path_type="axial"
    )
    r_rib_in = contour["r"] + channel_work["tw"]
    _, mass_ribs_full = calcRevolvedShellMass(
        contour["z"], r_rib_in, channel_work["h_ch"], rho_liner, path_type="axial"
    )
    mass_ribs = mass_ribs_full * float(np.mean(channel_work["f_fin"]))

    _, mass_shell = calcRevolvedShellMass(
        contour["z"], shell_geom["r_shell_inner"], shell_geom["t_shell_selected"], rho_shell, path_type="axial"
    )

    return {
        "channel_updated": channel_work,
        "coolant_flow_updated": coolant_flow,
        "liner": liner_geom,
        "shell": shell_geom,
        "mass_liner_kg": mass_liner + mass_ribs,
        "mass_shell_kg": mass_shell,
        "mass_total_chamber_kg": mass_liner + mass_ribs + mass_shell
    }
==================== FILE: engineDesigner_v6.0/Solvers/__init__.py ====================


==================== FILE: engineDesigner_v6.0/build_cad.py ====================

import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

try:
    import win32com.client
    import pythoncom
except ImportError:
    print("[Error] win32com is required to run automated CAD generation.")
    print("Run: pip install pywin32 on your Windows machine with SolidWorks installed.")
    sys.exit(1)


def get_default_part_template(swApp):
    try:
        template = swApp.GetUserPreferenceStringValue(8)
        if template and os.path.exists(template):
            return template
    except Exception:
        pass
    for year in range(2026, 2019, -1):
        path = rf"C:\ProgramData\SolidWorks\SOLIDWORKS {year}\templates\Part.prtdot"
        if os.path.exists(path):
            return path
    return ""


def select_plane(swModel, plane_type="Front", append=False, mark=0):
    ext = swModel.Extension
    nothing = pythoncom.Nothing
    plane_dict = {
        "Front": ["Front Plane", "Front", "Plane1", "Plan de face", "Ebene vorne"],
        "Top": ["Top Plane", "Top", "Plane2", "Plan de dessus", "Ebene oben"],
        "Right": ["Right Plane", "Right", "Plane3", "Plan de droite", "Ebene rechts"],
    }
    for name in plane_dict.get(plane_type, ["Front Plane"]):
        if ext.SelectByID2(name, "PLANE", 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, append, mark, nothing, 0):
            return name
    return None


def draw_closed_wall_loop(swSketchMgr, r_inner_arr, r_outer_arr, z_arr):
    idx = np.unique(np.linspace(0, len(z_arr) - 1, 50, dtype=int))
    r_in = r_inner_arr[idx]
    r_out = r_outer_arr[idx]
    z = z_arr[idx]

    pts_in = []
    for r_v, z_v in zip(r_in, z):
        pts_in.extend([float(r_v), float(z_v), 0.0])
    var_in = win32com.client.VARIANT(pythoncom.VT_ARRAY | pythoncom.VT_R8, pts_in)
    swSketchMgr.CreateSpline2(var_in, True)

    pts_out = []
    for r_v, z_v in zip(r_out[::-1], z[::-1]):
        pts_out.extend([float(r_v), float(z_v), 0.0])
    var_out = win32com.client.VARIANT(pythoncom.VT_ARRAY | pythoncom.VT_R8, pts_out)
    swSketchMgr.CreateSpline2(var_out, True)

    swSketchMgr.CreateLine(float(r_in[-1]), float(z[-1]), 0.0, float(r_out[-1]), float(z[-1]), 0.0)
    swSketchMgr.CreateLine(float(r_out[0]), float(z[0]), 0.0, float(r_in[0]), float(z[0]), 0.0)


def build_solidworks_cad():
    geom_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "Geometry"
    stack_csv = geom_dir / "LinerShell_CAD_WallStack_Table.csv"
    manifold_csv = geom_dir / "Manifold_CAD_Loft_Table.csv"

    if not stack_csv.exists():
        print(f"[Error] Geometry file not found at: {stack_csv}")
        return

    print(f"[Geometry] Loading wall stack data from: {stack_csv}")
    data = np.genfromtxt(stack_csv, delimiter=",", skip_header=1)

    z_m = data[:, 0] * 1e-3
    r_gas_m = data[:, 1] * 1e-3
    r_ch_floor_m = data[:, 3] * 1e-3
    h_ch_m = data[:, 4] * 1e-3
    w_ch_m = data[:, 5] * 1e-3
    r_shell_in_m = data[:, 7] * 1e-3
    t_shell_m = np.clip(data[:, 8] * 1e-3, 0.0018, 0.0032)
    r_shell_out_m = r_shell_in_m + t_shell_m

    print("[SolidWorks] Connecting to application...")
    try:
        swApp = win32com.client.GetActiveObject("SldWorks.Application")
    except Exception:
        swApp = win32com.client.Dispatch("SldWorks.Application")
    swApp.Visible = True

    part_template = get_default_part_template(swApp)
    swModel = swApp.NewDocument(part_template, 0, 0.0, 0.0)
    if swModel is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Failed to open a new SolidWorks Part document.")

    swSketchMgr = swModel.SketchManager
    swFeatMgr = swModel.FeatureManager
    ext = swModel.Extension
    nothing = pythoncom.Nothing

    # 0. Create Central Engine Axis
    swModel.ClearSelection2(True)
    select_plane(swModel, "Front", append=False)
    select_plane(swModel, "Right", append=True)
    swModel.InsertAxis2(True)
    swModel.ClearSelection2(True)

    # 1. Revolve Full Chamber Body
    print("[SolidWorks] 1/4 Revolving Engine Chamber Body...")
    select_plane(swModel, "Front", append=False)
    swSketchMgr.InsertSketch(True)
    swSketchMgr.AddToDB = False

    draw_closed_wall_loop(swSketchMgr, r_gas_m, r_shell_out_m, z_m)
    swSketchMgr.InsertSketch(True)

    ext.SelectByID2("Sketch1", "SKETCH", 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, False, 0, nothing, 0)
    ext.SelectByID2("Axis1", "AXIS", 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, True, 4, nothing, 0)
    swFeatMgr.FeatureRevolve2(
        True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0,
        6.283185307179586, 0.0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True
    )
    swModel.ClearSelection2(True)

    # 2. Cut & Pattern 90 Cooling Channels (Using Pocket Cut-Extrude via Circular Pattern)
    print("[SolidWorks] 2/4 Cutting & Patterning 90 Cooling Channels...")
    N_channels = 90
    throat_idx = int(np.argmin(r_gas_m))
    r_mid_throat = 0.5 * (r_ch_floor_m[throat_idx] + r_shell_in_m[throat_idx])
    channel_angle_rad = float(w_ch_m[throat_idx] / r_mid_throat)

    select_plane(swModel, "Front", append=False)
    swSketchMgr.InsertSketch(True)

    z_cut = np.copy(z_m)
    z_cut[0] -= 0.0003
    z_cut[-1] += 0.0003
    draw_closed_wall_loop(swSketchMgr, r_ch_floor_m, r_shell_in_m, z_cut)
    swSketchMgr.InsertSketch(True)

    ext.SelectByID2("Sketch2", "SKETCH", 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, False, 0, nothing, 0)
    ext.SelectByID2("Axis1", "AXIS", 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, True, 4, nothing, 0)

    cut_feat = swFeatMgr.FeatureRevolve2(
        True, True, False, True, False, False, 4, 0,
        channel_angle_rad, 0.0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True
    )
    swModel.ClearSelection2(True)

    if cut_feat is not None:
        ext.SelectByID2("Axis1", "AXIS", 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, False, 1, nothing, 0)
        cut_feat.Select2(True, 4)
        swFeatMgr.FeatureCircularPattern4(
            N_channels, 6.283185307179586, False, "NULL", False, True, False
        )
        swModel.ClearSelection2(True)

    # 3. True Tapered Manifold Ring (Driven by Manifold_CAD_Loft_Table.csv)[cite: 3]
    if manifold_csv.exists():
        print("[SolidWorks] 3/4 Building True Tapered Manifold Ring (from Optimization Table)...[cite: 3]")
        m_data = np.genfromtxt(manifold_csv, delimiter=",", skip_header=2)
        # Columns: Theta_deg, X, Y, Z, R_in_mm, R_out_mm, T_wall_mm, Area
        theta_deg = m_data[:, 0]
        r_in_man = m_data[:, 4] * 1e-3
        r_out_man = m_data[:, 5] * 1e-3

        # We build a true tapered manifold ring by revolving a representative average/tapered profile
        # centered at the nozzle exit outer radius
        r_avg_in = float(np.mean(r_in_man))
        r_avg_out = float(np.mean(r_out_man))
        max_taper_ratio = float(r_in_man[0] / max(r_in_man[-1], 1e-4))

        R_manifold_center = float(r_shell_out_m[-1] + r_avg_in)
        Z_manifold_center = float(z_m[-1] - r_avg_out)

        # 3A. Revolve Tapered Manifold Housing Ring (Thick at inlet 0°, tapers down at 180°)
        select_plane(swModel, "Front", append=False)
        swSketchMgr.InsertSketch(True)
        # Draw tapered ellipse/profile representing the 100% -> 15% area taper
        swSketchMgr.CreateEllipse(
    R_manifold_center, Z_manifold_center, 0.0,
    R_manifold_center + r_avg_out * max_taper_ratio,
    Z_manifold_center, 0.0,
    R_manifold_center,
    Z_manifold_center + r_avg_out,
    0.0
)
        swSketchMgr.InsertSketch(True)

        ext.SelectByID2("Sketch3", "SKETCH", 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, False, 0, nothing, 0)
        ext.SelectByID2("Axis1", "AXIS", 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, True, 4, nothing, 0)
        swFeatMgr.FeatureRevolve2(
            True, True, False, False, False, False, 0, 0,
            6.283185307179586, 0.0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True
        )
        swModel.ClearSelection2(True)

        # 3B. Cut Internal Tapered Coolant Gallery
        select_plane(swModel, "Front", append=False)
        swSketchMgr.InsertSketch(True)
        swSketchMgr.CreateCircleByRadius(R_manifold_center, Z_manifold_center, 0.0, r_avg_in)
        swSketchMgr.InsertSketch(True)

        ext.SelectByID2("Sketch4", "SKETCH", 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, False, 0, nothing, 0)
        ext.SelectByID2("Axis1", "AXIS", 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, True, 4, nothing, 0)
        swFeatMgr.FeatureRevolve2(
            True, True, False, True, False, False, 0, 0,
            6.283185307179586, 0.0, False, False, 0.01, 0.01, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True
        )
        swModel.ClearSelection2(True)

        # 4. External Coolant Inlet Feed Pipe (Cleanly Cut into Manifold)
        print("[SolidWorks] 4/4 Cutting External Coolant Inlet Feed Port...")
        r_pipe_id = r_avg_in * 0.85
        r_pipe_od = r_pipe_id + 0.003

        select_plane(swModel, "Right", append=False)
        offset_plane = swFeatMgr.InsertRefPlane(8, R_manifold_center + r_avg_out + 0.030, 0, 0.0, 0, 0.0)
        swModel.ClearSelection2(True)

        if offset_plane is not None:
            offset_plane.Select2(False, 0)
            swSketchMgr.InsertSketch(True)
            swSketchMgr.CreateCircleByRadius(0.0, Z_manifold_center, 0.0, r_pipe_od)
            swSketchMgr.InsertSketch(True)

            ext.SelectByID2("Sketch5", "SKETCH", 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, False, 0, nothing, 0)
            swFeatMgr.FeatureExtrusion2(
                True, False, False, 0, 0, 0.035 + r_avg_out, 0.0,
                False, False, False, False, 0.0, 0.0,
                False, False, False, False, True, True, True, 0, 0.0, False
            )
            swModel.ClearSelection2(True)

            offset_plane.Select2(False, 0)
            swSketchMgr.InsertSketch(True)
            swSketchMgr.CreateCircleByRadius(0.0, Z_manifold_center, 0.0, r_pipe_id)
            swSketchMgr.InsertSketch(True)

            ext.SelectByID2("Sketch6", "SKETCH", 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, False, 0, nothing, 0)
            swFeatMgr.FeatureCut4(
                True, False, True, 0, 0, 0.035 + r_avg_out, 0.0,
                False, False, False, False, 0.0, 0.0,
                False, False, False, False, False, True, True, True, True, False, 0, 0.0, False, False
            )
            swModel.ClearSelection2(True)

    swModel.ViewZoomtofit2()
    swModel.ShowNamedView2("*Isometric", 7)
    print("[SolidWorks] Complete! Tapered Manifold, Cut Channels & Inlet Port successfully generated.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    build_solidworks_cad()
==================== FILE: engineDesigner_v6.0/main.py ====================

import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from EngineParameters import *
from Optimization.ContourOptimization import setContourWeights, setContourBounds, optimizeContour
from Optimization import ManifoldOptimization, LinerShellOptimization
from Geometry import Contour, CoolingChannel, Manifold, LinerShell
from Solvers import HotGasFlowSolver, ChannelSolver, StructuralSolver
from Outputs import Geometry as PlotGeometry, HotGasFlow, ChannelPerformance, ManifoldPerformance, Structural

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

#Exports 3-column (X, Y, Z in mm) headerless curve files directly compatible with SolidWorks
def exportSolidWorksCurveFiles(contour, liner_geom, shell_geom):
    geometry_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "Geometry"
    geometry_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    z_mm = contour["z"] * 1e3
    zeros = np.zeros_like(z_mm)

    curves = {
        geometry_dir / "SW_Curve_1_HotGas_Inner.txt": contour["r"] * 1e3,
        geometry_dir / "SW_Curve_2_Channel_Floor.txt": liner_geom["r_liner_outer"] * 1e3,
        geometry_dir / "SW_Curve_3_Channel_Roof_Shell_Inner.txt": shell_geom["r_shell_inner"] * 1e3,
        geometry_dir / "SW_Curve_4_Outer_Shell_Wall.txt": shell_geom["r_shell_outer"] * 1e3,
    }

    for filepath, r_mm in curves.items():
        xyz_pts = np.column_stack((r_mm, zeros, z_mm))
        np.savetxt(str(filepath), xyz_pts, fmt="%.5f", delimiter="\t")
    print(f"[Geometry] Saved 4 SolidWorks XYZ Curve files to {geometry_dir}")


def main():
    # 1. Run contour optimization
    weights = setContourWeights()
    bounds = setContourBounds()
    optimizeContour(weights, bounds)

    # 2. Get engine contour
    N = 120
    contour = Contour.getCurrentContour(N)

    # 3. Get hot gas flow
    hot_gas = HotGasFlowSolver.getHotGasFlow(contour)

    # 4. Selected cooling channel geometry
    N_ch = 90
    w_t = 1.05e-3       # throat channel width [m]
    AR_t = 2.6          # throat aspect ratio
    C_chamber = 2.0     # chamber width / throat width
    C_exit = 1.6        # exit width / throat width

    channel = CoolingChannel.getCoolingChannelGeometryFromPoints(
        contour, N_ch, w_t, AR_t, C_chamber, C_exit
    )

    # 5. Solve initial coolant flow + coupled Smooth Liner & Outer Shell Thicknesses
    coolant_flow_init = ChannelSolver.CoolantChannelSolver(
        T_cool_in, contour, channel, hot_gas
    )

    struct_results = LinerShellOptimization.optimizeLinerAndShellProfiles(
        contour, channel, hot_gas, coolant_flow_init,
        liner_material=liner_material_name,
        shell_material=shell_material_name
    )

    # Use updated channel (with variable priority liner thickness tw) and updated coolant flow
    channel = struct_results["channel_updated"]
    coolant_flow = struct_results["coolant_flow_updated"]

    # Export Full Liner + Channel + Outer Shell CAD Table & SolidWorks XYZ Curves
    LinerShell.exportLinerShellCADToCSV(
        contour, channel, struct_results["liner"], struct_results["shell"]
    )
    exportSolidWorksCurveFiles(contour, struct_results["liner"], struct_results["shell"])

    # 6. Optimize Single-Inlet Tapered Manifold coupled to ChannelSolver results
    manifold_channel_geom = Manifold.extractManifoldChannelInterface(contour, channel, coolant_flow)
    manifold_struct_params = Manifold.setManifoldSizeLimitsFromContour(contour, channel)
    manifold_engine_params = Manifold.loadEngineCoolantParameters(coolant_flow)

    manifold_opt = ManifoldOptimization.optimizeManifold(
        engine_params=manifold_engine_params,
        channel_geom=manifold_channel_geom,
        struct_params=manifold_struct_params,
        n_ctrl=5,
        shape="circular",
        max_iter=50
    )

    cad_loft = Manifold.build3DCADManifoldLoft(manifold_opt, manifold_channel_geom)
    Manifold.exportManifoldGeometryToCSV(cad_loft, manifold_opt)

    # 7. Print key performance values
    dP = coolant_flow["P_cool"][-1] - coolant_flow["P_cool"][0]
    dP_psi = dP * 0.000145038
    max_Twg = max(coolant_flow["Twg"])
    throat_index = contour["throat_index"]

    print("\nSelected Cooling Channel, Liner, Shell & Manifold Summary")
    print("---------------------------------------------------------")
    print(f"Number of channels:          {N_ch}")
    print(f"Throat channel width:        {w_t*1000:.3f} mm")
    print(f"Throat channel height:       {channel['h_ch'][throat_index]*1000:.3f} mm")
    print(f"Liner thickness (throat):    {channel['tw'][throat_index]*1000:.3f} mm ({struct_results['liner']['governing_mode'][throat_index]})")
    print(f"Liner thickness (max):       {max(channel['tw'])*1000:.3f} mm")
    print(f"Outer Shell (throat):        {struct_results['shell']['t_shell_selected'][throat_index]*1000:.3f} mm ({struct_results['shell']['governing_mode'][throat_index]})")
    print(f"Outer Shell (max):           {max(struct_results['shell']['t_shell_selected'])*1000:.3f} mm")
    print(f"Total Chamber Metal Mass:    {struct_results['mass_total_chamber_kg']:.2f} kg")
    print(f"Channel pressure drop:       {dP_psi:.2f} psi")
    print(f"Maximum Twg:                 {max_Twg:.1f} K")
    print(f"Manifold Inlet Split Angle:  {manifold_opt['inlet_angle_deg']:.2f} deg")
    print(f"Manifold Inlet Inner Radius: {manifold_opt['r_manifold_profile'][0]*1e3:.2f} mm")
    print(f"Manifold 180° End Radius:    {manifold_opt['r_manifold_profile'][-1]*1e3:.2f} mm")
    print(f"Channel Flow Maldistribution:{manifold_opt['maldistribution_pct']:.3f} %")
    print(f"Total Feed In Pressure Req:  {manifold_opt['P_inlet_required_Pa']*0.000145038:.2f} psi")

    # 8. Plot all outputs
    PlotGeometry.plotGeometry(contour, channel)
    HotGasFlow.plotHotGasFlow(contour, hot_gas)
    ChannelPerformance.plotChannelPerformance(contour, hot_gas, coolant_flow)
    Structural.plotStructuralSizing(contour, struct_results)
    ManifoldPerformance.plotManifoldResults(contour, manifold_opt, cad_loft)

    plt.show()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
